name: schema-form
purpose: A form rendered from a JSON schema: each property of an object schema becomes a `Field` with its label, description, Required marker and control, and a nested object becomes a fieldset with its own legend. It edits one value object through `v-model`, seeds the schema's defaults, validates the supported draft-07 keywords with built-in messages (on leaving a field, or only after `validate()`), and shows server messages passed by field path. It is for forms whose fields are data (a function's arguments, an integration's settings), not for forms a designer lays out by hand.
useWhen: A function, template or integration declares its own arguments as a JSON schema and the console must ask for them.
The same settings form must follow a schema the server sends (fields added or removed without a release).
A form of typed values (text, choices, numbers, switches, lists) with constraints that already live in a schema.
avoidWhen: A form with a fixed, designed layout (settings sections, create pages) → compose `field`, `input`, `select` and `switch` by hand (`platform/edit/edit-resource`, `platform/create/single-page-create`).
Rows of key/value pairs the user adds and removes → use `attribute-editor`.
Editing the schema itself, or raw JSON → use `code-editor`.
A single choice or value → use the control directly inside a `field`.
related: field` — the wrapper every generated field uses; SchemaForm adds no field chrome of its own.
input`, `select`, `switch`, `textarea` — the controls it renders per type.
attribute-editor` — user-defined key/value rows, where SchemaForm renders a fixed set of keys.
code-editor` — the JSON view of the same value, when the user prefers to type it.
bestPractices: Give every property a `title` and a one-sentence `description`; the key is only the fallback label.
Put limits in the schema (`minimum`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, `enum`) so the form checks them; say the rule in the `description` when it is a `pattern`, since the built-in message cannot name it.
Keep the default `validate-on="blur"` for short forms; use `submit` when the form sits in a drawer or dialog with one Save.
Call `validate()` on submit and stop when it returns `valid: false`; it shows every message and focuses the first invalid field.

Pass server rejections in `errors` keyed by path (`origin.host`): the field turns invalid with that message until the user edits it (the form-error rule). Put a section-level failure in an `Alert` above the form, not in `errors`.
Use a `field:<path>` slot for a control the schema cannot express (`RadioCards`, a resource picker); the slot keeps the label, description and messages.

Do not rely on unsupported keywords (`$ref`, `oneOf`, `anyOf`, `allOf`, `if`/`then`, `const`, `format`, `uniqueItems`, `multipleOf`, `additionalProperties`): they are ignored, so validate them on the server.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON schema of an object (draft-07 subset); each property becomes a Field.

props.name: errors
props.doc: Server or external messages by field path; a field shows its message until it is edited.

props.name: ui
props.doc: Presentation overrides by field path: widget, placeholder, hidden, and key order (`''` is the root).

props.name: validateOn
props.doc: When fields first show their validation message: on leaving the field, or only after `validate()`.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Shows every value without letting it change.

examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioCards from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-cards'
  import SchemaForm from '@aziontech/webkit/schema-form'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const schema = {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      mode: {
        type: 'string',
        title: 'Cache mode',
        enum: ['honor', 'override'],
        default: 'honor'
      },
      ttl: { type: 'integer', title: 'TTL (seconds)', minimum: 0, default: 3600 },
      notes: { type: 'string', title: 'Notes', 'x-multiline': true }
    }
  }

  const ui = { '': { order: ['ttl', 'mode'] }, notes: { placeholder: 'Why this cache policy' } }
  const settings = ref({})
</script>

<template>
  <SchemaForm
    v-model="settings"
    :schema="schema"
    :ui="ui"
    class="max-w-(--container-sm)"
  >
    <template #field:mode="{ value, setValue, disabled }">
      <RadioCards
        :model-value="value"
        aria-label="Cache mode"
        :items="[
          {
            value: 'honor',
            label: 'Honor origin headers',
            description: 'Cache for as long as the origin says.'
          },
          {
            value: 'override',
            label: 'Override with TTL',
            description: 'Cache for the TTL below, whatever the origin says.'
          }
        ]"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @update:model-value="setValue"
      />
    </template>
  </SchemaForm>
</template>
